changeSet.author: ${claude}
changeSet.comment:
Audit trail of holdings relocated between wallets (issue #245). History only: nothing in the app's totals derives from it.
The holdings are stored by external id with no foreign key, and name and ticker are snapshotted, because a merge deletes the origin holding and the row must outlive it. The wallet references are SET NULL rather than CASCADE so deleting an emptied origin wallet does not erase the move from the destination's history.
changeSet.sql: CREATE TABLE finances.wallet_moves ( id BIGINT GENERATED ALWAYS AS IDENTITY PRIMARY KEY, external_id UUID NOT NULL DEFAULT gen_random_uuid() UNIQUE, origin_wallet_id BIGINT NULL REFERENCES finances.wallets(id) ON DELETE SET NULL, destination_wallet_id BIGINT NULL REFERENCES finances.wallets(id) ON DELETE SET NULL, kind finances.wallet_kind NOT NULL, origin_holding_external_id UUID NOT NULL, destination_holding_external_id UUID NOT NULL, holding_name TEXT NOT NULL, ticker TEXT NULL, quantity NUMERIC NULL CHECK (quantity > 0), moved_at DATE NOT NULL, created_at TIMESTAMPTZ NOT NULL DEFAULT now() );

changeSet.author: ${claude}
changeSet.sql: CREATE INDEX idx_wallet_moves_origin_wallet_id ON finances.wallet_moves (origin_wallet_id); CREATE INDEX idx_wallet_moves_destination_wallet_id ON finances.wallet_moves (destination_wallet_id);
